subject: Security review kickoff + scope clarification \u0014 Patiently Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@patientlyhealth.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@patientlyhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff + scope clarification  Patiently Health

Hi Alex & Sophie,

Thanks again for a great demo earlier  really appreciated the walkthrough of your use cases around patient engagement and analytics. As discussed, we want to kick off the security review so we can confirm scope and timelines for getting Patiently Health set up in production.

Quick recap / asks:
- Intake: attached is our security questionnaire (security-questionnaire-v1.pdf). Can you fill the sections you know and flag any items that need follow-up? If helpful, a partial fill is fine  we can walk through open items on a kickoff call.
- Systems in scope: please confirm the systems you want in scope for the review (suggested list below). Call out any 3rd-party SaaS that store PHI.
  - Production app (AWS EKS, primary cluster)
  - Staging/dev environments (if you want them reviewed)
  - Analytics/data warehouse (Snowflake)
  - CRM (HubSpot)
  - SSO provider (Okta)
  - Any third-party vendors that hold PHI (e.g., labs, texting vendors)
- Stakeholder mapping: please provide the economic buyer, technical reviewer(s), legal/procurement contact, and anyone who should be on the kickoff. We typically include a security technical contact and a procurement/legal contact to speed contract questions.
- Timeline: our standard intake window is 12 weeks for questionnaire completion; target security review complete ~34 weeks after kickoff (we can tighten if needed). Please confirm any hard dates (procurement windows, board deadlines, etc.).

Proposed next steps:
1) You (Alex/Sophie) complete the questionnaire and return it to me by Monday 8/30.
2) Schedule a 60-min kickoff to walk through answers and clarify access (workspace credentials, evidence links)  I have availability next Tue/Wed morning PDT.
3) Share any SOC 2 or penetration test reports you already have; if not, we can provide guidance on evidence collection.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (answerable form)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D-security-evidence (shared evidence folder  will add links after kickoff)

Thanks  happy to hop on a quick call if anything here is unclear.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Customer Trust
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

---

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@patientlyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@patientlyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff + scope clarification  Patiently Health

Hi Marissa,

Thanks  this is helpful. We started filling the questionnaire and attaching the partial spreadsheet (security-questionnaire-partial-fill.xlsx). A few quick answers / clarifications from our side:

Systems in scope (confirmed):
- Production web app (AWS EKS cluster, us-east-1)  contains PHI (patient messages and scheduling).
- Staging/dev: we prefer not to include full staging in the initial review; we can include key services if you recommend it.
- Analytics: Snowflake (managed, contains aggregated PHI-derived metrics).
- CRM: HubSpot (no PHI stored, but contact metadata).
- SSO: Okta (primary identity provider).
- Third parties: Twilio (messaging provider)  stores message content, YES PHI in some flows.

Stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Samantha Park  CFO <samantha.park@patientlyhealth.com>
- Technical reviewer: Marcus Li  DevOps Lead <marcus.li@patientlyhealth.com>
- Procurement/legal: procurement@patientlyhealth.com (procurement lead is an alias; legal will loop in if contract redlines appear)

Timeline / constraints:
- Procurement window: week of Sep 6 is ideal for contract review (Samantha will be available then).
- We can aim to complete the intake by Mon 8/30. Marcus will try to get the Snowflake architecture diagram and Okta settings docs into your Drive link by then.
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report from last year  happy to share via your evidence folder or a secure link.

Preference: we prefer to start on Redwoods hosted offering with data residency in us-east-1. If procurement requests, we may discuss Dedicated later.

I can join the kickoff  Marcus and Samantha should join the technical/procurement portions. Sophie will coordinate internal docs.

Attaching: security-questionnaire-partial-fill.xlsx
Links: internal architecture doc (we'll upload to the Drive folder you provided)

Let me know available kickoff slots next Tue/Wed morning PDT.

Thanks,
Alex
Customer Success Lead, Patiently Health
alex.johnson@patientlyhealth.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@patientlyhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@patientlyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff + scope clarification  Patiently Health

Alex  perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and the stakeholder list. Quick notes:
- We'll accept your SOC 2 Type II via the Drive link; please set permissions to allow viewing or send a secure link.
- For the initial review we'll include production + analytics + Twilio integration (PHI in scope). We won't require full staging unless Marcus recommends specific services to include.
- Neha (cc'd) will be our primary security reviewer and will coordinate evidence requests with Marcus. Sean will support procurement questions and the contract path for Dedicated vs Hosted.

I'm sending a calendar invite for a 60-min kickoff on Tue 8/24 at 09:00 AM PDT (tentative)  please accept or propose alternate. Agenda: introductions, walkthrough of questionnaire gaps, confirmation of systems in scope, evidence handoff, procurement timeline.

Next steps for Alex / Marcus / Samantha:
- Upload SOC 2 and architecture diagrams to the Drive folder by Mon 8/30 (if possible).
- Complete as much of the questionnaire as you can; we'll use the kickoff to resolve open items.
- Procurement: Sean will reach out separately to align on contract timing (target week of Sep 6).

Thanks everyone  looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa

PS: Neha  can you confirm if you need AWS account-level read access or just exported evidence (IAM policies, architecture diagrams)?
